decision_conditions: Condition : 1 - The development hereby permitted shall be begun before the expiration of three years from the date of this permission.
Condition : 2 - The advertisment display hereby approved shall be for a period of 5 years
Condition : 3 - Any advertisement displayed, and any site used for the display of advertisments, shall be maintained in a condition that does not impair the visual amenity of the site
Condition : 5 - Any structure or hoarding erected and used principally for the purpose of displaying advertisements shall be maintained in a condition that does not endanger the public
Condition : 6 - Where an advertisement is required under these Regulations to be removed, the site shall be left in a condition that does not endanger the public or impair visual amenity

Condition : 7 - The proposed development shall be carried out in all respects in accordance with the proposals contained in the application and the plans submitted (J000425_A0_00, J000425_A4_00, J000425_A4_01, J000425_A4_02. Received on 24 November 2015) therewith and approved by the Local Planning Authority, or as shall have been otherwise agreed in writing by the Local Planning Authority before the building is used.
description: Installation of one internally illuminated fascia sign and projecting sign at the front of the shop
